text:
Katie Ramos: Morning — quick async preflight for the spec + launch checklist. 
What I did: put up the revised spec for the routing + prefix cache changes (PR linked). Added behavioral tests for fallback logic.
Blockers: staging cluster still pending due to cloud quota, need a final canary run. Also one open question in the spec re: TTL for cached prefixes (see comments).
Today: iterate on comments, try to run perf tests on dev infra if staging unavailable, and get final sign-off from @Ajay. cc @Tasha for infra updates. :rocket:

Ajay Patel: Saw the PR, looks good overall. I left two small comments on the burst-routing section (edge case when requests spike and cache warmup + batching interaction). I can run the perf harness later today once you confirm payload shape.
Also can we include a microbenchmark table in the doc? helps steer quantization choices.

Miles Chen: I can prepare the perf harness and run locally if staging is blocked. Need a representative payload and a short trace sample (20 requests with mixed lengths). If we can't get staging, I can simulate cache misses/warmup by clearing KV and seeding a small set.
Suggestion: run `make perf-run MODEL=gpt-four-mini SEQ=512 BATCH=8` to approximate the p95; that'll be cheaper than full sized models.

Katie Ramos: payload sample: `[{"prompt": "user: summarize...", "max_tokens": 256}, ...]` — uploaded minimal sample to the PR description. I'll add the microbenchmark table skeleton.

Tasha Morgan: Infra update — staging nodes stuck at quota request with cloud support. Ticket #CS-3341, ETA ~3h. If we need faster feedback, we can grant temporary dev cluster access for perf runs (costs charged to the feature team). I'll post when quota clears.

ci-bot: Build 482 on branch `feature/prefix-cache` finished with status: flaky-failure. Failing tests: e2e/routing_flow_test (timeout). https://ci.internal/builds/482 :warning:

Ajay Patel: Noted the flaky e2e — I can re-run and also run a focused suite: `pytest tests/e2e/test_routing_flow.py::test_prefill_cache -k burst` to isolate. If flaky, we should add a retry wrapper in the test infra instead of changing logic.

Miles Chen: If e2e is flaky because of staging latency, local perf sim will still give useful deltas for batching/kv-warmup. I'll queue runs once Katie confirms the final payload.

Katie Ramos: Plan for today: 1) address spec comments and add microbenchmark table, 2) ask Ajay for a quick review after his perf run, 3) if staging blocked, merge with feature-flag off and schedule canary once quota cleared. Will ping for final sign-off. Thanks! :thumbsup:
